# FPSOT data types specification

> How FPSOT systems store and exchange data: text, dates and times, durations, time zones, numbers, money, identifiers, booleans, code values and coordinates, each with one JSON form and one LinkML type.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts and conformance.
- [Text](spec/en/text.adoc): DAT-001 to DAT-006.
- [Dates and times](spec/en/dates.adoc): DAT-010 to DAT-016.
- [Durations and intervals](spec/en/durations.adoc): DAT-020 to DAT-024.
- [Time zones](spec/en/time-zones.adoc): DAT-030 to DAT-034.
- [Numbers](spec/en/numbers.adoc): DAT-040 to DAT-043.
- [Money](spec/en/money.adoc): DAT-050 to DAT-055.
- [Identifiers](spec/en/identifiers.adoc): DAT-060 to DAT-067.
- [Booleans and code values](spec/en/codes.adoc): DAT-070 to DAT-073.
- [Coordinates](spec/en/geography.adoc): DAT-080 to DAT-082.
